data.claim: ddflow/surfaces/declared/lifecycle.py:34 names the CLAUDECODE harness marker directly inside _APPROVE_EPILOG; the marker table HARNESS_MARKERS is owned by ddflow/services/identity.py, and tests/test_identity_resolve.py::test_only_services_identity_defines_or_reads_the_agent_marker pins the literal to that file only, so the stray literal makes the test fail (main red).
data.falsifier: grep -rn CLAUDECODE ddflow/ shows the literal in a .py file other than services/identity.py; or the test still fails after removing the stray literal.
data.mechanism: The test rglobs ddflow/**/*.py and asserts {relative paths whose text contains CLAUDECODE} <= {'services/identity.py'}.
data.probe_output: before: surfaces/declared/lifecycle.py:34 and services/identity.py:102,104; after removing the stray literal from _APPROVE_EPILOG: only services/identity.py:102,104 remain.
data.question: Why is tests/test_identity_resolve.py red on main?

evidence.note: grep -rn CLAUDECODE ddflow/ before: surfaces/declared/lifecycle.py:34 + services/identity.py:102,104; after removing the stray literal from _APPROVE_EPILOG: only services/identity.py:102,104. Claim CONFIRMED (research Rb2cca2a231).
